name: sync-refusals-unpublished
breaks: a joiner reports the entries it refuses from a synced announcement
red: stores the entries with a name and hash, and refuses the one without
keeps the location it holds for a node past a newer announcement whose every entry it refuses

name: bad-entries-located
breaks: a location is made only of an entry with a string name and a string hash
red: stores the entries with a name and hash, and refuses the one without

name: every-refused-synced
breaks: a synced announcement whose every entry is refused does not take the place of the readable one
red: keeps the location it holds for a node past a newer announcement whose every entry it refuses
keeps the readable announcement in the log it serves its own peers
